name: Boston Marathon bombing
trigger: Two explosions in quick succession hit the finish line of the Boston Marathon in the afternoon, killing and injuring spectators; the FBI sends counterterrorism officials.
source_quote: Two explosions rocked the finish line of the Boston Marathon this afternoon, leaving at least three dead and dozens injured, the Boston Police Department reports

name: US government shutdown begins (2013)
trigger: Funding lapses at midnight after Congress fails to pass a spending bill, starting a partial shutdown of the federal government that closes national parks.
source_quote: A partial shutdown of the federal government has led to the closing of national parks.

name: Fed announces QE taper
trigger: The Federal Reserve says it will begin reducing the pace of its monthly asset purchases in January, citing progress toward maximum employment.
source_quote: In light of the cumulative progress toward maximum employment and the improvement in the outlook for labor market conditions, the Committee decided to modestly reduce the pace of its asset purchases.

name: Russia authorizes troops in Ukraine (Crimea)
trigger: Over the weekend Russia's upper house approves President Putin's request to use Russian forces in Ukraine, as armed men take over government buildings in Crimea.
source_quote: Russia's upper house of parliament has approved President Putin's request for Russian forces to be used in Ukraine. He had asked that Russian forces be used "until the normalisation of the political situation in the country".

name: OPEC declines to cut output
trigger: On the US Thanksgiving holiday, OPEC's conference in Vienna decides to keep its production level unchanged rather than cut output.
source_quote: Accordingly, in the interest of restoring market equilibrium, the Conference decided to maintain the production level of 30.0 mb/d, as was agreed in December 2011.

name: Greece rejects bailout terms in referendum
trigger: In a Sunday referendum Greek voters reject international creditors' bailout terms, raising fears that Greece could leave the eurozone.
source_quote: Greek voters have overwhelmingly rejected international creditors’ tough bailout terms, leading to fears that the cash-strapped nation was on its way out of the eurozone.

name: Paris terrorist attacks
trigger: On Friday night coordinated teams of gunmen and suicide bombers attack a concert hall, the national stadium, restaurants and bars in Paris; France's president calls it an act of war by Islamic State.
source_quote: The attacks in Paris on the night of Friday 13 November by gunmen and suicide bombers hit a concert hall, a major stadium, restaurants and bars, almost simultaneously - and left 130 people dead and hundreds wounded.

name: Fed December 2015 rate hike
trigger: The Federal Reserve raises its federal funds target range to a quarter to half a point, citing the economic outlook and the time policy takes to affect the economy.
source_quote: Given the economic outlook, and recognizing the time it takes for policy actions to affect future economic outcomes, the Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate to 1/4 to 1/2 percent.

name: Brussels airport and metro bombings
trigger: Morning bombs hit the departures area of Brussels Zaventem airport and a metro station near EU headquarters during rush hour.
source_quote: Twin blasts hit Zaventem airport at about 07:00 GMT, with 11 people reported killed. Another explosion struck Maelbeek metro station near EU headquarters an hour later, leaving about 20 people dead.

name: UK votes to leave the EU (Brexit)
trigger: Overnight results show UK voters have chosen to leave the European Union in a referendum, and Prime Minister David Cameron says he will resign.
source_quote: Voters in the U.K. have decided to leave the European Union, a decision that has shocked Europe, shaken global markets and pushed Prime Minister David Cameron to announce his upcoming resignation.

name: Manchester Arena bombing
trigger: After the US close, an explosion at an Ariana Grande concert at Manchester Arena in England kills and injures concertgoers.
source_quote: At least 20 people were killed and hundreds of injuries after an explosion was reported at an Ariana Grande at Manchester Arena in England.

name: Hurricane Harvey landfall in Texas
trigger: On Friday night Hurricane Harvey makes landfall as a Category 4 storm northeast of Corpus Christi, Texas, bringing 130 mph winds and flooding rains to the Gulf Coast.
source_quote: The National Hurricane Center said the eye of the Category 4 hurricane made landfall about 10 p.m. about 30 miles (48 kilometers) northeast of Corpus Christi between Port Aransas and Port O'Connor, bringing with it 130 mph (209 kph) sustained winds and flooding rains.

name: Facebook-Cambridge Analytica data harvesting revealed
trigger: Weekend reports reveal that Cambridge Analytica harvested millions of Facebook profiles of US voters to build software for targeting voters.
source_quote: The data analytics firm that worked with Donald Trump’s election team and the winning Brexit campaign harvested millions of Facebook profiles of US voters, in one of the tech giant’s biggest ever data breaches, and used them to build a powerful software program to predict and influence choices at the ballot box.

name: Section 301 tariff action against China
trigger: President Trump announces actions against China's technology transfer and intellectual property practices under Section 301, instructing USTR to propose a list of products for tariff increases within 15 days.
source_quote: Today President Trump announced his decisions on the actions the Administration will take in response to China’s unfair trade practices covered in the USTR Section 301 investigation of China’s Acts, Policies, and Practices Related to Technology Transfer, Intellectual Property, and Innovation.

name: Italy's populist government bid collapses
trigger: On Sunday Italy's prime minister-designate abandons his mandate after the president refuses to appoint a eurozone critic as economy minister, deepening a political crisis; US markets are closed Monday.
source_quote: Conte’s attempt at forming a government broke down after Mattarella refused to endorse Paolo Savona, a vocal critic of the European Union, for the post of minister of economy.

name: Fed insurance rate cut
trigger: The Federal Reserve lowers its federal funds target range by a quarter point, citing global developments and muted inflation pressures.
source_quote: In light of the implications of global developments for the economic outlook as well as muted inflation pressures, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate to 2 to 2-1/4 percent.

name: Drone strikes on Saudi Aramco's Abqaiq plant
trigger: On Saturday drone strikes claimed by Yemen's Houthi rebels hit Saudi Aramco's Abqaiq oil-processing facility and the Khurais oil field.
source_quote: Yemen's Houthi rebels have claimed responsibility for drone strikes on two Saudi Aramco oil facilities early Saturday, according to a statement by a Houthi spokesman.

name: US-China Phase One trade deal
trigger: The United States and China announce a Phase One trade agreement covering intellectual property, technology transfer, agriculture and currency, with the US agreeing to modify its Section 301 tariff actions.
source_quote: The United States and China have reached an historic and enforceable agreement on a Phase One trade deal that requires structural reforms and other changes to China’s economic and trade regime in the areas of intellectual property, technology transfer, agriculture, financial services, and currency and foreign exchange.

name: US strike kills Qassem Soleimani
trigger: The Pentagon says a US strike ordered by the president has killed Iranian Quds Force commander Qassem Soleimani in Iraq, raising the risk of Iranian retaliation.
source_quote: The Pentagon confirmed the death of Quds Force Commander General Qassem Soleimani in a statement late Thursday, saying the strike was launched, "at the direction" of U.S. President Donald Trump.

name: COVID-19 outbreak in northern Italy
trigger: Over the weekend Italy seals off a dozen northern towns to contain a cluster of COVID-19 cases, making Italy the focal point of the outbreak in Europe.
source_quote: Police manned checkpoints around quarantined towns in Italy's north on Monday as authorities sought to contain cases of COVID-19 virus that have made Italy the focal point of the outbreak in Europe and fears of its cross-border spread.

name: Fed emergency half-point cut (COVID)
trigger: In an unscheduled move, the Federal Reserve lowers its federal funds target range by half a point, citing the evolving risks the coronavirus poses to economic activity.
source_quote: However, the coronavirus poses evolving risks to economic activity. In light of these risks and in support of achieving its maximum employment and price stability goals, the Federal Open Market Committee decided today to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/2 percentage point, to 1 to 1‑1/4 percent.

name: WHO declares COVID-19 a pandemic
trigger: The World Health Organization announces that COVID-19, now reported in more than 100 countries, can be characterized as a pandemic.
source_quote: The COVID-19 viral disease that has swept into at least 114 countries and killed more than 4,000 people is now officially a pandemic, the World Health Organization announced Wednesday.

name: Fed cuts rates to zero (COVID)
trigger: In a Sunday evening announcement, the Federal Reserve lowers its federal funds target range to zero to a quarter point in response to the coronavirus outbreak.
source_quote: In light of these developments, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate to 0 to 1/4 percent.

name: OPEC+ record production cut
trigger: In a Sunday videoconference, OPEC and non-OPEC producers agree to cut crude oil production by 9.7 million barrels a day from May, followed by smaller cuts through April 2022.
source_quote: Adjust downwards their overall crude oil production by 9.7 mb/d, starting on 1 May 2020, for an initial period of two months that concludes on 30 June 2020.

name: Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine efficacy result
trigger: Before the open, Pfizer and BioNTech announce that their mRNA COVID-19 vaccine candidate shows efficacy in the first interim analysis of a Phase 3 trial.
source_quote: Pfizer Inc. (NYSE: PFE) and BioNTech SE (Nasdaq: BNTX) today announced their mRNA-based vaccine candidate, BNT162b2, against SARS-CoV-2 has demonstrated evidence of efficacy against COVID-19 in participants without prior evidence of SARS-CoV-2 infection, based on the first interim efficacy analysis conducted on November 8, 2020 by an external, independent Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) from the Phase 3 clinical study.

name: Ever Given blocks the Suez Canal
trigger: The container ship Ever Given runs aground and blocks the Suez Canal, stalling traffic through one of the world's busiest waterways.
source_quote: The Ever Given, sailing under a Panamanian flag bound for The Netherlands from China, ran aground Tuesday morning.

name: Omicron variant designated
trigger: The WHO designates the B.1.1.529 coronavirus variant, first reported from South Africa, a variant of concern named Omicron.
source_quote: Based on the evidence presented indicative of a detrimental change in COVID-19 epidemiology, the TAG-VE has advised WHO that this variant should be designated as a VOC, and the WHO has designated B.1.1.529 as a VOC, named Omicron.

name: Russia invades Ukraine
trigger: Overnight Russian military forces launch an attack on Ukraine; the US president calls it a premeditated war and promises a joint response with allies.
source_quote: The prayers of the entire world are with the people of Ukraine tonight as they suffer an unprovoked and unjustified attack by Russian military forces. President Putin has chosen a premeditated war that will bring a catastrophic loss of life and human suffering.

name: US bans Russian oil imports
trigger: President Biden signs an executive order banning US imports of Russian crude oil, certain petroleum products, liquefied natural gas and coal.
source_quote: Today’s Executive Order bans: The importation into the United States of Russian crude oil and certain petroleum products, liquefied natural gas, and coal.

name: Fed begins 2022 hiking cycle
trigger: The Federal Reserve raises its federal funds target range by a quarter point and signals that ongoing increases will be appropriate to bring down high inflation.
source_quote: In support of these goals, the Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate to 1/4 to 1/2 percent and anticipates that ongoing increases in the target range will be appropriate.

name: Fed three-quarter-point hike
trigger: The Federal Reserve raises its federal funds target range by three quarters of a point and says ongoing increases will be appropriate.
source_quote: In support of these goals, the Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate to 1‑1/2 to 1-3/4 percent and anticipates that ongoing increases in the target range will be appropriate.

name: UK mini-budget unfunded tax cuts
trigger: The UK Chancellor announces a Growth Plan of broad tax cuts, including abolishing the additional rate of income tax, alongside energy support for households.
source_quote: Alongside cutting the basic rate of income tax, the Chancellor also abolished the additional rate of tax, taking effect from April 2023. In its place will be a single higher rate of income tax of 40%.

name: Bank of England emergency gilt purchases
trigger: The Bank of England announces temporary purchases of long-dated UK government bonds to restore orderly conditions, warning that gilt market dysfunction threatens UK financial stability.
source_quote: Were dysfunction in this market to continue or worsen, there would be a material risk to UK financial stability. This would lead to an unwarranted tightening of financing conditions and a reduction of the flow of credit to the real economy. In line with its financial stability objective, the Bank of England stands ready to restore market functioning and reduce any risks from contagion to credit conditions for UK households and businesses. To achieve this, the Bank will carry out temporary purchases of long-dated UK government bonds from 28 September.

name: Silicon Valley Bank failure
trigger: California regulators close Silicon Valley Bank and appoint the FDIC as receiver; the FDIC moves insured deposits to a new deposit insurance bank.
source_quote: Silicon Valley Bank, Santa Clara, California, was closed today by the California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation, which appointed the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) as receiver.

name: US guarantees all SVB and Signature deposits
trigger: In a Sunday statement, Treasury, the Fed and the FDIC invoke a systemic risk exception so that all depositors of Silicon Valley Bank and Signature Bank are fully protected.
source_quote: After receiving a recommendation from the boards of the FDIC and the Federal Reserve, and consulting with the President, Secretary Yellen approved actions enabling the FDIC to complete its resolution of Silicon Valley Bank, Santa Clara, California, in a manner that fully protects all depositors.

name: UBS takeover of Credit Suisse
trigger: Swiss authorities arrange a weekend takeover of Credit Suisse by UBS with state support, and Credit Suisse's AT1 bonds are written down in full.
source_quote: In close coordination with FINMA, the Swiss Confederation and the SNB, UBS will take over Credit Suisse in full. The extraordinary government support will trigger a complete write-down of the nominal value of all AT1 debt of Credit Suisse in the amount of around CHF 16 billion

name: Fed hikes during bank stress
trigger: The Federal Reserve raises its federal funds target range by a quarter point despite recent bank failures, stating that the banking system is sound and resilient.
source_quote: In support of these goals, the Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate to 4-3/4 to 5 percent.

name: Surprise OPEC+ voluntary output cuts
trigger: On Sunday Saudi Arabia and other OPEC+ members announce voluntary oil production cuts of more than one million barrels a day from May through year-end.
source_quote: Saudi Arabia, the world’s biggest oil exporter and Opec's largest producer , will cut its output by 500,000 bpd from May until the end of the year, the kingdom's Ministry of Energy said on Sunday.

name: First Republic Bank failure
trigger: California regulators close First Republic Bank before the open and the FDIC sells its deposits and most assets to JPMorgan Chase.
source_quote: First Republic Bank, San Francisco, California, was closed today by the California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation, which appointed the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) as receiver. To protect depositors, the FDIC is entering into a purchase and assumption agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank, National Association, Columbus, Ohio, to assume all of the deposits and substantially all of the assets of First Republic Bank

name: WHO ends COVID-19 global emergency
trigger: The World Health Organization says COVID-19 no longer qualifies as a global emergency.
source_quote: The World Health Organization said Friday that COVID-19 no longer qualifies as a global emergency, marking a symbolic end to the devastating coronavirus pandemic that triggered once-unthinkable lockdowns, upended economies worldwide and killed at least 7 million people worldwide.

name: Nvidia's AI-driven revenue outlook
trigger: After the close (8-K accepted 4:22 pm ET), Nvidia reports record data center revenue and guides next-quarter revenue to about 11 billion dollars.
source_quote: Revenue is expected to be $11.00 billion, plus or minus 2%.

name: US debt ceiling agreement in principle
trigger: Late Saturday President Biden and House Speaker McCarthy reach an agreement in principle to raise the debt ceiling and avert a US default; US markets are closed Monday.
source_quote: President Joe Biden and House Speaker Kevin McCarthy reached an “agreement in principle” to raise the nation’s legal debt ceiling late Saturday as they raced to strike a deal to limit federal spending and avert a potentially disastrous U.S. default .

name: Fitch downgrades US credit rating
trigger: After the close, Fitch Ratings cuts the US credit rating one notch from AAA, citing expected rising government debt and a steady deterioration in standards of governance.
source_quote: Fitch Ratings has downgraded the U.S. credit rating, citing an expected increase in government debt over the next three years and a "steady deterioration in standards of governance" over the past two decades.

name: Hamas attack on Israel
trigger: On Saturday Hamas militants launch a surprise attack from Gaza into southern Israel under a rocket barrage, and Israel declares it is at war with Hamas.
source_quote: Under cover of a barrage of rockets, dozens of Hamas militants broke out of the blockaded Gaza Strip and into nearby Israeli towns, killing dozens and abducting others in an unprecedented surprise early morning attack during a major Jewish holiday Saturday. A stunned Israel said it is now at war with Hamas and launched airstrikes in Gaza, vowing to inflict an "unprecedented price."

name: Taiwan's strongest earthquake since 1999
trigger: A magnitude 7.4 earthquake strikes near Hualien, Taiwan, on Wednesday morning local time, before the US open, and chipmaker UMC evacuates some facilities.
source_quote: The quake hit at 7:58 a.m. local time Wednesday and measured 7.4 in magnitude, according to the US Geological Survey, which pinned the epicenter near the eastern city of Hualien.

name: Iran's first direct attack on Israel
trigger: Over the weekend Iran launches drones and ballistic missiles directly at Israel for the first time, raising fears of a regionwide war.
source_quote: Booms and air raid sirens sounded in Jerusalem early Sunday after Iran launched dozens of drones and ballistic missiles toward Israel in an unprecedented revenge mission that pushed the Middle East ever closer to a regionwide war. The attack marked the first time Iran has launched a direct military assault on Israel, despite decades of enmity dating back to the country's 1979 Islamic Revolution.

name: Macron dissolves parliament after EU vote
trigger: On Sunday evening French President Emmanuel Macron dissolves the National Assembly and calls snap legislative elections after a heavy defeat by the far right in the European elections.
source_quote: President Emmanuel Macron dissolved the lower house of France's parliament in a surprise announcement sending voters back to the polls in the coming weeks to choose lawmakers, after his party was handed a humbling defeat by the far-right in the European elections Sunday.

name: CrowdStrike global IT outage
trigger: A defective CrowdStrike Falcon content update for Windows hosts causes a widespread outage for its customers; the company says it was not a cyberattack.
source_quote: The outage was caused by a defect found in a Falcon content update for Windows hosts. Mac and Linux hosts are not impacted. This was not a cyberattack.

name: Bank of Japan raises rates and slows JGB buying
trigger: The Bank of Japan raises its short-term policy rate target to around 0.25 and adopts a plan to cut monthly government bond purchases to about 3 trillion yen by early 2026.
source_quote: At the Monetary Policy Meeting (MPM) held today, the Policy Board of the Bank of Japan decided, by a 7-2 majority vote, to set the following guideline for money market operations for the intermeeting period: [Note] The Bank will encourage the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 0.25 percent.

name: WHO declares mpox global emergency
trigger: The World Health Organization declares the mpox outbreaks in Congo and elsewhere in Africa a global emergency as a new form of the virus spreads.
source_quote: The World Health Organization has declared the mpox outbreaks in Congo and elsewhere in Africa a global emergency, with cases confirmed among children and adults in more than a dozen countries and a new form of the virus spreading.

name: Fed opens easing cycle with a half-point cut
trigger: The Federal Reserve lowers its federal funds target range by half a point, citing progress on inflation and the balance of risks.
source_quote: In light of the progress on inflation and the balance of risks, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/2 percentage point to 4-3/4 to 5 percent.

name: South Korea martial law declaration
trigger: South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol declares emergency martial law in a televised briefing, accusing the opposition of anti-state activities.
source_quote: South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol declared an "emergency martial law," Tuesday accusing the country's opposition of controlling the parliament, sympathizing with North Korea and paralyzing the government with anti-state activities.

name: Tariffs on Canada, Mexico and China
trigger: Over the weekend President Trump signs orders under emergency powers imposing additional tariffs on imports from Canada and Mexico and a smaller additional tariff on imports from China.
source_quote: Until the crisis is alleviated, President Donald J. Trump is implementing a 25% additional tariff on imports from Canada and Mexico and a 10% additional tariff on imports from China.

name: Liberation Day reciprocal tariffs
trigger: After the close, President Trump announces a baseline tariff on virtually all imports plus higher reciprocal tariffs on countries with large trade surpluses with the US.
source_quote: S&P 500 futures lost about 2% after Trump unveiled the new tariffs this afternoon, just after the stock market closed at 4 p.m.

name: 90-day pause on reciprocal tariffs
trigger: President Trump pauses the higher reciprocal tariffs on most nations for 90 days while raising the tariff rate on Chinese imports.
source_quote: Facing a global market meltdown, President Donald Trump on Wednesday abruptly backed down on his tariffs on most nations for 90 days, but raised the tax rate on Chinese imports to 125 percent.

name: US license requirement on Nvidia H20 chips to China
trigger: After the close (8-K accepted 5:22 pm ET), Nvidia discloses that the US government requires a license, indefinitely, to export its H20 chips to China, and expects up to 5.5 billion dollars of related charges.
source_quote: On April 14, 2025, the USG informed the Company that the license requirement will be in effect for the indefinite future. The Company’s first quarter of fiscal year 2026 ends on April 27, 2025. First quarter results are expected to include up to approximately $5.5 billion of charges associated with H20 products for inventory, purchase commitments, and related reserves.

name: US-China Geneva tariff truce
trigger: The US and China issue a joint statement after talks in Geneva: each side suspends most of its recent additional tariffs on the other for an initial 90 days.
source_quote: The United States will (i) modify the application of the additional ad valorem rate of duty on articles of China (including articles of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the Macau Special Administrative Region) set forth in Executive Order 14257 of April 2, 2025, by suspending 24 percentage points of that rate for an initial period of 90 days, while retaining the remaining ad valorem rate of 10 percent on those articles pursuant to the terms of said Order;

name: Moody's downgrades US credit rating
trigger: On Friday evening Moody's strips the US government of its top Aaa credit rating, citing successive governments' failure to stop rising debt.
source_quote: Moody's Ratings stripped the U.S. government of its top credit rating Friday, citing successive governments' failure to stop a rising tide of debt.

name: Israel strikes Iran's nuclear program
trigger: Israel launches dozens of preemptive airstrikes on Iranian nuclear facilities, scientists and senior military commanders in an operation it calls Rising Lion.
source_quote: The Israeli military targeted Iranian nuclear facilities, research scientists and senior military commanders in dozens of preemptive airstrikes early Friday morning in what it dubbed "Operation Rising Lion."

name: US strikes Iranian nuclear sites
trigger: On Saturday the US military strikes three Iranian nuclear and military sites, joining Israel's campaign against Iran.
source_quote: President Donald Trump addressed the nation from the East Room of the White House on Saturday after the U.S. military struck three Iranian nuclear and military sites.

name: Israel-Iran ceasefire
trigger: A ceasefire between Israel and Iran announced by President Trump takes effect after an initial violation by both sides.
source_quote: President Donald Trump said a ceasefire between Iran and Israel was in effect Tuesday after the deal initially faltered and the American leader expressed deep frustration with both sides.

name: Fed resumes rate cuts
trigger: The Federal Reserve lowers its federal funds target range by a quarter point, citing a shift in the balance of risks.
source_quote: In support of its goals and in light of the shift in the balance of risks, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 4 to 4‑1/4 percent.

name: US government shutdown begins (2025)
trigger: The US government shuts down after President Trump and Congress fail to agree on funding by the start of the fiscal year.
source_quote: Plunged into a government shutdown, the U.S. is confronting a fresh cycle of uncertainty after President Donald Trump and Congress failed to strike an agreement to keep government programs and services running by Wednesday's deadline.

name: Fed December 2025 rate cut
trigger: The Federal Reserve lowers its federal funds target range by a quarter point, following cuts in September and October, citing the shift in the balance of risks.
source_quote: In support of its goals and in light of the shift in the balance of risks, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 3-1/2 to 3‑3/4 percent.

name: Fed reverses course with a rate hike
trigger: The Federal Reserve raises its federal funds target range by a quarter point after holding it steady at every earlier 2026 meeting, saying inflation remains elevated.
source_quote: The Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 3-3/4 to 4 percent, in support of the Federal Reserve's dual mandate.
